title: Yudan Beribi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Kiddushin 21b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.21b.7), Rabbi Elazar says, “Yudan Beribi used to expound.” (Rashi explains that Yudan was his name and he was a great man of his generation.) Bekhorot 36b cites: “The rabbis taught—Rabbi Yudan said: Berabi used to expound: When they pierce,” etc., “and the Sages say,” etc. This wording suggests that Rabbi Yudan said that Beribi used to expound. The source, however, is Sifrei, Reeh, on “You shall take the awl,” where it reads: “Rabbi Elazar said: Yudan Beribi used to expound.” If so, he is Rabbi Elazar ben Shammua.[^1]

notes.text: Beribi is an honorific for an eminent scholar; the quoted Bekhorot wording also allows it to be read as the subject, as Hyman explains. His final identification remains conditional.
